incident.name: PowerSchool Data Breach
incident.description: Attackers used stolen credentials to access PowerSchool's student information system, exposing data of 62M+ students and teachers across thousands of school districts in the US and Canada.
incident.root_cause: No MFA on maintenance portal, credentials stolen via infostealer malware
incident.lessons: Education sector SIS platforms hold sensitive PII for millions of minors and require MFA and strict access controls.

relatedIncidents.name: Conficker Worm
relatedIncidents.description: Conficker infected 9-15 million Windows machines, creating one of the largest botnets ever. Exploited unpatched Windows RPC.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Automated patch management and network monitoring are essential.

relatedIncidents.name: Cegedim Santé Healthcare Breach
relatedIncidents.vector: Unauthorized access to healthcare SaaS platform
relatedIncidents.description: 15.8M French patient records stolen from Cegedim's MonLogicielMedical platform used by 3,800 doctors. Included sensitive free-text notes with HIV status, psychiatric diagnoses, and sexual orientation. Breach occurred Oct 2025, disclosed March 2026 — 4 months later.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Delayed breach disclosure, insufficient access controls on healthcare SaaS
relatedIncidents.lessons: Healthcare SaaS platforms holding sensitive clinical notes require the highest security standards. Breach disclosure delays harm patients.

relatedIncidents.name: Crunchyroll Third-Party Breach
relatedIncidents.vector: Phished Telus International contractor Okta SSO
relatedIncidents.description: Attacker phished a Telus International support contractor's Okta SSO credentials, gaining access to Crunchyroll's Zendesk, Slack, Google Workspace, and Jira. 8M support tickets and 6.8M user email addresses exfiltrated in under 24 hours.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Third-party contractor SSO compromise, insufficient monitoring of bulk data exports
relatedIncidents.lessons: Third-party contractor access must be monitored for anomalous bulk exports. SSO without phishing-resistant MFA is insufficient.
